properties.displayName: HTTP Brute Force - Repeated Auth Failures on /auth/login/
properties.description: Detects repeated 401/403 HTTP responses on /auth/login/ from a single client IP within a short window, indicating a credential brute-force attempt. Based on AppServiceHTTPLogs (application layer), complementing the existing kernel-layer Defender NMap detection. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1110 (Brute Force).
properties.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where CsUriStem == "/auth/login/"
| where ScStatus in (401, 403)
| summarize FailedAttempts = count(), Methods = make_set(CsMethod), UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent) by CIp, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where FailedAttempts > 10
| project TimeGenerated, CIp, FailedAttempts, Methods, UserAgents
